generation.mode: built-in ImageGen edit with edit-target as Image 1 and style canon as reference-only Image 2

lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; final water-mask pixels and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No whole-cell sun gradient or cast-shadow field is visible, but repeated light column caps above darker vertical faces violate the literal equal-value-on-all-sides rule. The aggregate isotropy metric cannot override that visual defect.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: manual estimated fraction of non-water land area at native source resolution
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: Only coherent upper bench areas count as buildable; sea-cliff and gully faces count as steep; talus, broken margins, stack rock, and the conifer gully make up the remainder.

east.required: open sea across the edge; terrain ends mid-ground

west.required: preserve the authored Wild coast handoff

crown.method: Manual outer-foliage width census of every visible crown at native source scale, including all small and south-edge-clipped crowns; native median 31.5 px scaled by 2560/1254.

waterMask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
waterMask.method: Flooded the source-raster blue and teal sea from the canvas edges, grew a narrow pale surf-and-wash collar, closed pixel-scale gaps, and filled small enclosed wet speckles; five full dry stack/islet components remain unmasked as terrain.

refusalReasons: The eastern edge contains 404 land pixels; the brief requires open sea on the east and terrain ending mid-ground.
The candidate violates the highest-priority lighting wording: repeated pale column caps above darker vertical faces expose an upper-face lighting convention.
openRisks: Several cliff runs retain a repeated vertical-column rhythm; owner visual review is required against the ordinary-coast ban on accidental regular palisades.
The small north-side shingle cove is not clearly distinguishable from talus at native resolution.
The water mask overlay follows surf and inlet wash at native resolution, but no pipeline bake was run because the task is quarantine-only.
